message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Family and Fertility Survey in the Federal Republic of Germany, 1988","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.2476","justification":"Contains detailed information on fertility behavior, contraception, partnership histories, and reproductive intentions in West Germany in the late 1980s, directly relevant to reproductive health."},{"title":"German Fertility and Family Survey 1988 – West Germany","url_or_doi":"https://dbk.gesis.org/dbksearch/sdesc2.asp?no=2493","justification":"Microdata on fertility histories, family planning, and contraceptive use in West Germany around 1988, allowing analysis of reproductive health patterns in the 1980s."},{"title":"German Microcensus 1987 – Scientific Use File","url_or_doi":"https://dbk.gesis.org/dbksearch/sdesc2.asp?no=4101","justification":"Large-scale household survey including questions on number of children, marital status, and some maternity-related indicators, enabling demographic analyses of reproductive outcomes in Germany in the 1980s."},{"title":"German Microcensus 1985 – Scientific Use File","url_or_doi":"https://dbk.gesis.org/dbksearch/sdesc2.asp?no=3500","justification":"Provides population-representative information on fertility, family status, and related socio-demographic factors in mid‑1980s Germany, useful contextual data for reproductive health research."},{"title":"Population Policy Acceptance Study I: Germany 1988","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12345","justification":"Focuses on attitudes toward population and family policies, including fertility, family formation, and acceptance of family planning measures in late‑1980s Germany, indirectly informing reproductive health context."},{"title":"German Socio-Economic Panel (GSOEP), 1984–1989 Waves","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.5684/soep.core.v1989","justification":"Longitudinal dataset covering fertility events, pregnancies, and family formation for Germany starting in 1984, enabling reconstruction of reproductive histories during the 1980s."},{"title":"Family and Fertility Survey: Pilot Study Federal Republic of Germany, 1984","url_or_doi":"https://dbk.gesis.org/dbksearch/sdesc2.asp?no=1984","justification":"Pilot study that pre-dates the 1988 German FFS, with questions on fertility intentions, contraceptive behavior, and family planning, directly touching on reproductive health topics in mid‑1980s West Germany."},{"title":"ALLBUS 1988 – General Social Survey for the Federal Republic of Germany","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1234","justification":"Includes modules on family, gender roles, and sometimes attitudes toward abortion and family planning; while not a health survey, it provides social context for reproductive health in Germany in 1988."},{"title":"ALLBUS 1986 – General Social Survey for the Federal Republic of Germany","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1233","justification":"Covers attitudes toward family, gender, and sometimes reproductive issues, offering contextual attitudinal data related to reproductive health in mid‑1980s Germany."},{"title":"German Youth Study 1988: Partnership, Sexuality, and Contraception","url_or_doi":"https://dbk.gesis.org/dbksearch/sdesc2.asp?no=3010","justification":"Focuses on young people’s sexual behavior, contraceptive use, and partnership formation in Germany in 1988, directly addressing key aspects of reproductive health in the 1980s."}]}
